section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1983
title: 12 ## Accidental Deaths by Sex Male victims of accidental deaths accounted for 66·6 per cent of the total accidental deaths in the country during 1983 while the female victims were 33·4%. The ratio of male and female victims for the States as a whole was 62·2% and 33·8% respectively while for the Union Territories as a whole it was 77·5% and 22·5% respectively. This percentage of male and female victims for the Metropolitan Cities as a whole was 66·6% and 33·4% respectively i.e. equal to the national ratio.
